P : ἄριστος ex correctura M. 21 πολλοὺς scripsi : τοὺς P ; κατὰ - τόπους et δὲ om. M. 22 ἐλείψουσιν M. Quae sequuntur post πηγαί in cod. M omissa sunt usque ad annum VII alterius dode- caeteridos. 23 ζʹ addidi. 24 ἀεροπλήγιον : vocabulum videtur adhuc ignotum. 26 πρὸ ἓξ P. 27 κγʹ P : correxi, v. prolegomena. 28 ἔαρ ἀνέχον μέχρι τροπῶν θερινῶν : cf. sections.en: 2 πάσης ('of all') P M. 3 δεῖ ('it is necessary') I have written : διὰ ('through') P M. εἰωθῶσι ('they are accustomed') P. ἄθητον ('unplaced') P. Cf. Geop., I, 12, 21. 4 ὑπάρξει ('will be') P. βοσκήματα ('cattle') M. 6 After ὑπάρξει ('will be') in M falsely crept in ἀπὸ δύσεως καὶ μεσημβρίας ('from the west and south'): see the next words concerning the year of the Virgin. 7 Ἔ. π. ('Y. f.') P : ςʹ ('6') M. 8 Ἤξει ('Will come') P M. 10 ἀναλογοῦντα ('corresponding') M. Almost the same in Geop., § 23. 11 καὶ τὸ θέρος ('and the summer') I have added. 12 ὑπὸ ('under') P. εἰ- κβʹ ('if- 22') deleted in M, where are read: ἀπὸ ἐπιτολῆς δὲ κυνὸς ἔσονται κτλ. ('but from the rising of the Dog Star there will be etc.'). στάσις ('standing') P : ἥτις ἐστί ('which is') I have written. πρὸ δὲ ('but before') P : <τῇ> πρὸ ιʹ ('<on the> 10th before') I have written. αὐγούστου κατὰ ῥωμαίους ('of August according to the Romans') P. 13 ὥστε - φθαρῆναι ('so as - to be destroyed') omitted by M. τὸν σιτικὸν ('the grain') I have written : τὸ νοητικόν ('the intellectual') P. 15 καὶ λυβαίου ('and of the southwest wind') P. καὶ - ὄμβρους ('and - rainstorms') (20) omitted by M. 16 φορ. καὶ ('fruitful and') I have added. 18 ἐφυστηρεῖ ('will be late') P. καὶ ('and') I have written : κατὰ ('according to') P. 20 μὲν ('on the one hand') P : γοῦν ('at any rate') M. φ. κ. εὔκρ. ('f. and well-tempered') P : ἄριστος ('best') from a correction M. 21 πολλοὺς ('many') I have written : τοὺς ('the') P ; κατὰ - τόπους ('in - places') and δὲ ('but') omitted by M. 22 ἐλείψουσιν ('will fail') M. The things which follow after πηγαί ('springs') in codex M are omitted up to year VII of the other dodecaeteris. 23 ζʹ ('7') I have added. 24 ἀεροπλήγιον ('wind-beaten'): the word seems hitherto unknown. 26 πρὸ ἓξ ('before six') P. 27 κγʹ ('23') P : I have corrected, see the prolegomena. 28 ἔαρ ἀνέχον μέχρι τροπῶν θερινῶν ('spring holding up until the summer solstice') : cf. Geop., § 27 : τοῦ δὲ θέρους ἡ ἀρχὴ ἔαρι ἔσται ὁμοία ('and the beginning of summer will be like spring').

summary.headline: Virgo and Libra Year Prognostics
summary.text: Astrological weather and agricultural prognostics for Year 6 of Virgo and Year 7 of Libra, covering winds, seasonal conditions, rains, sowing, crops, fruit, animals, people, and springs.
